## Setup

Run this document from the project root. It loads the packages and the
functions in `src/`.

```{r}
source("src/setup.R")
```

## Simulated dream journal

We simulate 180 nights of one dreamer (`src/simulate_journal.R`). Stress
follows a weekly rhythm; stressful days lead to later bedtimes, shorter and
worse sleep, and a higher chance of a negative dream. Dream texts are built
from templates whose words appear in the word lists in `data/lexicons/`, so
the app can detect themes, emotions, people and objects in them.

```{r}
journal <- simulate_dream_journal(n_nights = 180, seed = 2026)
head(journal[, c("date", "bedtime", "sleep_hours", "stress", "themes", "emotions")])
```

The app saves new entries to `data/dream_journal.csv`. If that file does not
exist yet, we start it with the simulated nights (existing entries are kept).

```{r}
journal_path <- "data/dream_journal.csv"
if (!file.exists(journal_path)) write_journal(journal, journal_path)
```

## The app

Run the chunk below in RStudio (or `source("src/setup.R"); run_dream_app()` in
an R console). It does not launch while rendering this document.

| Tab | What it shows |
|-----|---------------|
| New entry | Log a night; *Suggest* ticks themes and emotions found in your text |
| Calendar | Day, week or month view, coloured by dream valence, stress or sleep |
| Themes | Heat map of themes over time (one colour per theme) and stress per theme |
| Emotions | Affective map (valence × arousal; Russell, 1980) and emotions over time |
| People & objects | Who and what recur in your dreams |
| Sleep | Sleep routine trends and rule-based recommendations |
| Search | Full-text search with highlighted matches |

```{r}
if (interactive()) run_dream_app(journal_path)
```
